segments.text: Gumgumi's lounging in the sunny yard.
After a while, the skin looked different.
It's not just damage - the body's actually defending itself.
UV rays push deep into skin cells and hurt them.
So skin makes more pigment to fight back.
That pigment caps the nucleus to block the UV.
Pigment builds up across many cells.
So skin tans - and if it's too long, it turns into a sunburn.
